title: GitHub - cloudflarebase/cloudflarebase: The open-source Firebase for Cloudflare.
excerpt: The open-source Firebase for Cloudflare. Contribute to cloudflarebase/cloudflarebase development by creating an account on GitHub.
content_html:
Live demo · Deploy your own · Contributing

An open-source Firebase alternative that runs entirely on your Cloudflare account. Each project gets its own Durable Object running Better Auth on embedded SQLite, plus a dashboard with live counters, analytics, an AI copilot, and a generated API reference.

Auth is the first primitive. Database, storage, and the rest will follow the same shape.

Run it locally

git clone https://github.com/cloudflarebase/cloudflarebase.git
cd cloudflarebase
npm install
npm run dev

Open http://localhost:5173/dashboard. There are no secrets to set up. Local dev runs in demo mode, so you get a throwaway project without signing in.

Deploy your own

Two Workers. The agent goes first because the dashboard binds to it by name (Cloudflare's deploy button does one Worker per click).

  1. Agent:
  2. Dashboard:

Or from a clone: npm run deploy:all.

Then open the dashboard and create the first account. That account owns the console and sign-up closes behind it. Your install is private by default.

A deployment trusts its own origin automatically, so sign-in works right after deploy with nothing to configure. If you serve the console from another domain or call the API from other apps, add those origins to TRUSTED_ORIGINS (the CSRF allowlist) or per project under Settings.

Optional extras, all off until configured: Google/GitHub sign-in, email delivery, Sentry, and analytics SQL reads (CF_ACCOUNT_ID + CF_ANALYTICS_API_TOKEN with Account Analytics Read).

Add auth to a Worker you already have

The console is optional. The agent is a normal npm package, and the CLI wires it into an existing Worker project:

npm install -g @cloudflarebase/cli

cloudflarebase init my-backend   # or `cloudflarebase add auth` in an existing project
cd my-backend
npx wrangler login
cloudflarebase deploy            # sign-in works right away

add merges the agent's wrangler config into yours without overwriting anything you set, exports the Durable Object class from your entrypoint, and adds a type assertion so a missing binding fails at compile time with its name.

Use it from your app

The API is Better Auth, so its client works as-is:

import { createAuthClient } from 'better-auth/client';

const authClient = createAuthClient({
	baseURL: 'https://your-dashboard.workers.dev/api/projects/my-app/auth'
});

await authClient.signUp.email({ name, email, password });

Browsers get a cookie; everything else uses the set-auth-token bearer token. Add your app's origin under the project's Settings tab first. Each project also serves an OpenAPI 3.1 document at /api/projects/<id>/openapi.json, rendered in the dashboard under API Reference.

Checks

npm run check   # svelte-check
npm run lint    # prettier + eslint
npm test        # Playwright against real workerd

Security

Report vulnerabilities privately via SECURITY.md. Keep DEMO_MODE unset anywhere real users live.

License

Apache-2.0. Cloudflarebase is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Cloudflare, Inc. See NOTICE.

content_html_zh:
现场演示 · 部署您自己的 · 贡献

完全在您的 Cloudflare 帐户上运行的开源 Firebase 替代方案。 每个项目都有自己的持久对象，在嵌入式 SQLite 上运行 Better Auth，以及带有实时计数器、分析、AI 副驾驶和生成的 API 参考的仪表板。

Auth 是第一个原语。 数据库、存储和其他部分将遵循相同的形状。

本地运行

git clone https://github.com/cloudflarebase/cloudflarebase.git
cd cloudflarebase
npm install
npm run dev

打开 http://localhost:5173/dashboard。没有什么秘密可以设置。 本地开发以演示模式运行，因此您无需登录即可获得一次性项目。

部署您自己的

两名工人。 代理首先运行，因为仪表板按名称绑定到它（Cloudflare 的部署按钮每次单击执行一个 Worker）。

  1. Agent:
  2. 仪表板：

或者从克隆：npm run deploy:all。

然后打开仪表板并创建第一个帐户。 该帐户拥有该控制台，并且注册将在其后关闭。 默认情况下，您的安装是私有的。

部署会自动信任其自己的来源，因此部署后即可立即登录，无需进行任何配置。 如果您从另一个域提供控制台或从其他应用程序调用 API，请将这些源添加到 TRUSTED_ORIGINS（CSRF 白名单）或“设置”下的每个项目。

可选附加功能，在配置之前全部关闭：Google/GitHub 登录、电子邮件发送、Sentry 和分析 SQL 读取（CF_ACCOUNT_ID + CF_ANALYTICS_API_TOKEN 与帐户分析读取）。

将身份验证添加到您已有的 Worker

控制台是可选的。 代理是一个普通的 npm 包，CLI 将其连接到现有的 Worker 项目中：

npm install -g @cloudflarebase/cli

cloudflarebase init my-backend   # or `cloudflarebase add auth` in an existing project
cd my-backend
npx wrangler login
cloudflarebase deploy            # sign-in works right away

add 将代理的牧马人配置合并到您的配置中，而不覆盖您设置的任何内容，从入口点导出持久对象类，并添加类型断言，以便缺少的绑定在编译时以其名称失败。

从您的应用程序中使用它

该 API 是 Better Auth，因此其客户端按原样工作：

import { createAuthClient } from 'better-auth/client';

const authClient = createAuthClient({
	baseURL: 'https://your-dashboard.workers.dev/api/projects/my-app/auth'
});

await authClient.signUp.email({ name, email, password });

浏览器获取 cookie；其他一切都使用 set-auth-token 不记名令牌。 首先在项目的“设置”选项卡下添加应用程序的来源。 每个项目还提供位于 /api/projects/<id>/openapi.json 的 OpenAPI 3.1 文档，该文档在仪表板中的 API 参考下呈现。

支票

npm run check   # svelte-check
npm run lint    # prettier + eslint
npm test        # Playwright against real workerd

安全

通过 SECURITY.md 私下报告漏洞。 在真实用户居住的任何地方都保持 DEMO_MODE 未设置。

执照

阿帕奇-2.0。 Cloudflarebase 是一个独立项目，不隶属于 Cloudflare, Inc. 也不受其认可。请参阅“通知”。
